changes.text: 莱尔和胡克把这一条件告诉达尔文后，达尔文同意由他们自行处置他的手稿。在采取现行做法、把材料提交林奈学会时，他们又向达尔文说明了理由，而这理由不止是替两人分先后：他们说，这样做不只是考虑他与他的朋友谁更有优先权，而是为了科学的整体利益。他们认为，建立在大量事实之上、经多年思考而成熟的观点，应当立刻成为别人可以出发的目标；又补了一句实在话：在科学界等待达尔文完整著作问世期间，先把他的一些主要研究结果，连同那位能干的通信者的结果，一起摆到公众面前。

When Lyell and Hooker put this condition to Darwin, he gave them permission to make what use they thought proper of his memoir. In adopting their present course of presenting it to the Linnean Society, they explained to him that their grounds went beyond ranking two men: "we are not solely considering the relative claims to priority of himself and his friend, but the interests of science generally". They held that views founded on a wide deduction from facts, and matured by years of reflection, should "constitute at once a goal from which others may start". Then a plain practical point: while the scientific world was waiting for Darwin's complete work, some of the leading results of his labours, together with those of his able correspondent, should be laid before the public.

dispositions.rationale: 改正了先后顺序和因果关系。修改后的写法是：莱尔和胡克先把“不得扣下手稿”这一条件转告达尔文，达尔文随即授权；“为了科学的整体利益”这番理由，是他们在采取现行做法、提交林奈学会时才向达尔文说明的。这样不再暗示达尔文是因这些理由而授权。中英两版同步修改，其余句子保持不变。

evidence.quote: On representing this to Mr. Darwin, he gave us permission to make what use we thought proper of his memoir, &c.; and in adopting our present course, of presenting it to the Linnean Society, we have explained to him that we are not solely considering the relative claims to priority
